source.name: Z-Anatomy — The libre 3D atlas of anatomy (derived from BodyParts3D)
source.modificationNotes: Converted from a Z-Anatomy OBJ export (vertices, per-vertex normals, triangulated faces) to GLB by MEDHELP atlas-pipeline convertMesh(); axis-converted from Blender world space (Z-up) to glTF world space (Y-up).
